overall: The AG found the Milton Warrant Committee violated the Open Meeting Law by posting an insufficiently specific October 11 notice, which it cured on October 25; the October 18 notice was found sufficiently specific.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged that the October 11 notice topics (a proposed historic district warrant article and a land-transfer warrant article) lacked sufficient specificity.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the notice of the October 11 meeting was not sufficiently specific as to the topics that are the subject of the complaint.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged that the October 18 notice topic on amending the FY2024 budget warrant article was not sufficiently specific.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we find that notice of the October 18 meeting was sufficiently specific as to the topic referenced in the complaint.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law's notice requirements.
No further remedial action, because the Committee cured the violation by posting more specific notice for its October 25 meeting.
remedy_passage: We order immediate and future compliance with the law’s requirements.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
